name: TiinyBench
tagline: Measure what your box actually does, not what the spec sheet says.
description: Prefill against prompt length, throughput over a long generation, what happens when more than one person uses the box, and what a reasoning model charges for the tokens nobody reads. Produces one self-contained HTML report you can email. The Chat page asks the same box a question instead of a benchmark and puts the cost under every reply: time to first token, decode rate, tokens in and out, and why generation stopped, all read off the gateway's own timings and usage.

asks_for.why: to run timed calls against your models
to reach the Tiiny on your own network
results are plain JSON, one file per run

privacy.stores: Timing results as JSON, and a generated HTML report.
